scientific_integrity: The explicit theorem is proved using standard character theory; checker results are finite corroboration. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires odd moduli and unit-residue generators; full equidistribution does not follow from Fourier magnitudes alone.
Finite checks corroborate but do not prove the unlimited result; the proof invokes classical Dirichlet L(1,chi) nonvanishing.
A mathematically equivalent result in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Two-level cyclic autocorrelation is equivalent to signed doubling symmetry of subset-sum generators
